# Later status of the historical source-order audit

The original audit, metadata and source snapshots in this directory are
preserved byte-for-byte. They record the earlier fixed-S interface and its
then-open losses/slots-before-FirstTail-S gate; the audit adds zero proof roots.

The later [source-after-slots three-root replay](../../upstream/plain-kappa/verification/source-after-slots3/strict-replay-result.json)
now verifies a genuine strengthened interface: fixed W/scalar geometry,
positive scalar losses, actual energy mesh and physical slots, then any positive
detector e and prime seed, then a constructed SourceExclusions/FirstTail(4e)
prime set with nonzero product, then native degree/J/common height before outer
characters. The bound covers all matching source batches and nonempty fibers.
The earlier existentials were not interchanged.

The supplied e may be instantiated with a future genuine detector parameter
chosen from slot-dependent budgets. This does not construct the other HighData
budgets, the complete four-field Moments record, unrestricted RawMomentInput,
improved counts or the physical probe. Unmarked source-wide state/scale caps
and the inverse fields remain open. The original HighData fixes total slots
at 1/6; the variable-total source data and remaining budgets still need their
own construction. This status note is outside the frozen
historical audit and is covered by the current documentation hash index.
